mapper.insert: INSERT INTO amz_fba_inventory_age_group_summary ( pull_month, region_code, region_name, group_code, group_name, shop_count, source_row_count, inventory_0_90_qty, inventory_0_90_cost, inventory_91_180_qty, inventory_91_180_cost, inventory_181_plus_qty, inventory_181_plus_cost, total_inventory_qty, total_inventory_cost, pulled_at, create_time, update_time ) SELECT grouped.pull_month, CASE WHEN grouped.group_code = 'EU' THEN 'EU' ELSE 'US' END, CASE WHEN grouped.group_code = 'EU' THEN '欧洲组' ELSE '美国组' END, grouped.group_code, grouped.group_code, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN grouped.sid > 0 THEN grouped.sid END), COUNT(*), COALESCE(SUM(grouped.inv_age_0_to_90_days), 0), COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN REPLACE(TRIM(COALESCE(grouped.inv_age_0_to_90_price, '')), ',', '') REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN CAST(REPLACE(TRIM(grouped.inv_age_0_to_90_price), ',', '') AS DECIMAL(24, 6)) ELSE 0 END ), 0), COALESCE(SUM(grouped.inv_age_91_to_180_days), 0), COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN REPLACE(TRIM(COALESCE(grouped.inv_age_91_to_180_price, '')), ',', '') REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN CAST(REPLACE(TRIM(grouped.inv_age_91_to_180_price), ',', '') AS DECIMAL(24, 6)) ELSE 0 END ), 0), COALESCE(SUM(grouped.inv_age_181_to_270_days), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(grouped.inv_age_271_to_365_days), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(grouped.inv_age_365_plus_days), 0), COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN REPLACE(TRIM(COALESCE(grouped.inv_age_181_to_270_price, '')), ',', '') REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN CAST(REPLACE(TRIM(grouped.inv_age_181_to_270_price), ',', '') AS DECIMAL(24, 6)) ELSE 0 END ), 0) + COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN REPLACE(TRIM(COALESCE(grouped.inv_age_271_to_365_price, '')), ',', '') REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN CAST(REPLACE(TRIM(grouped.inv_age_271_to_365_price), ',', '') AS DECIMAL(24, 6)) ELSE 0 END ), 0) + COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN REPLACE(TRIM(COALESCE(grouped.inv_age_365_plus_price, '')), ',', '') REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN CAST(REPLACE(TRIM(grouped.inv_age_365_plus_price), ',', '') AS DECIMAL(24, 6)) ELSE 0 END ), 0), COALESCE(SUM(grouped.inv_age_0_to_90_days), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(grouped.inv_age_91_to_180_days), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(grouped.inv_age_181_to_270_days), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(grouped.inv_age_271_to_365_days), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(grouped.inv_age_365_plus_days), 0), COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN REPLACE(TRIM(COALESCE(grouped.inv_age_0_to_90_price, '')), ',', '') REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN CAST(REPLACE(TRIM(grouped.inv_age_0_to_90_price), ',', '') AS DECIMAL(24, 6)) ELSE 0 END ), 0) + COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN REPLACE(TRIM(COALESCE(grouped.inv_age_91_to_180_price, '')), ',', '') REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN CAST(REPLACE(TRIM(grouped.inv_age_91_to_180_price), ',', '') AS DECIMAL(24, 6)) ELSE 0 END ), 0) + COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN REPLACE(TRIM(COALESCE(grouped.inv_age_181_to_270_price, '')), ',', '') REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN CAST(REPLACE(TRIM(grouped.inv_age_181_to_270_price), ',', '') AS DECIMAL(24, 6)) ELSE 0 END ), 0) + COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN REPLACE(TRIM(COALESCE(grouped.inv_age_271_to_365_price, '')), ',', '') REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN CAST(REPLACE(TRIM(grouped.inv_age_271_to_365_price), ',', '') AS DECIMAL(24, 6)) ELSE 0 END ), 0) + COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN REPLACE(TRIM(COALESCE(grouped.inv_age_365_plus_price, '')), ',', '') REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN CAST(REPLACE(TRIM(grouped.inv_age_365_plus_price), ',', '') AS DECIMAL(24, 6)) ELSE 0 END ), 0), MAX(grouped.pulled_at), NOW(), NOW() FROM ( SELECT snapshot.*, CASE WHEN shop.store_name LIKE 'EU-%' OR ( snapshot.sid = 0 AND ( snapshot.seller_group_name LIKE 'EU-%' OR snapshot.name LIKE 'AMZ-EU-%' ) ) THEN 'EU' WHEN shop.store_name LIKE 'US1-%' THEN 'US1' WHEN shop.store_name LIKE 'US2-%' THEN 'US2' WHEN shop.store_name LIKE 'US3-%' THEN 'US3' ELSE NULL END AS group_code FROM amz_fba_inventory_monthly_snapshot snapshot LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sid, MAX(store_name) AS store_name FROM shop_list WHERE platform_code = '10001' AND sid IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sid ) shop ON CAST(snapshot.sid AS CHAR CHARACTER SET utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = shop.sid COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci WHERE snapshot.pull_month = #{pullMonth} ) grouped WHERE grouped.group_code IN ('EU', 'US1', 'US2', 'US3') GROUP BY grouped.pull_month, grouped.group_code
mapper.select:
SELECT id, pull_month, region_code, region_name, group_code, group_name, shop_count, source_row_count, inventory_0_90_qty, inventory_0_90_cost, inventory_91_180_qty, inventory_91_180_cost, inventory_181_plus_qty, inventory_181_plus_cost, total_inventory_qty, total_inventory_cost, pulled_at FROM amz_fba_inventory_age_group_summary WHERE pull_month =
#{pullMonth}
(SELECT MAX(x.pull_month) FROM amz_fba_inventory_age_group_summary x)
ORDER BY FIELD(group_code, 'EU', 'US1', 'US2', 'US3')

SELECT pull_month, COUNT(*) AS group_count, COALESCE(SUM(inventory_0_90_qty), 0) AS inventory_0_90_qty, COALESCE(SUM(inventory_0_90_cost), 0) AS inventory_0_90_cost, COALESCE(SUM(inventory_91_180_qty), 0) AS inventory_91_180_qty, COALESCE(SUM(inventory_91_180_cost), 0) AS inventory_91_180_cost, COALESCE(SUM(inventory_181_plus_qty), 0) AS inventory_181_plus_qty, COALESCE(SUM(inventory_181_plus_cost), 0) AS inventory_181_plus_cost, COALESCE(SUM(total_inventory_qty), 0) AS total_inventory_qty, COALESCE(SUM(total_inventory_cost), 0) AS total_inventory_cost, MAX(pulled_at) AS pulled_at FROM amz_fba_inventory_age_group_summary WHERE pull_month =
#{pullMonth}
(SELECT MAX(x.pull_month) FROM amz_fba_inventory_age_group_summary x)
GROUP BY pull_month
